source_caption:
🎬 Mask (1985)

Mask tells the emotional true story of Rocky Dennis, a remarkable teenager born with a rare condition called craniodiaphyseal dysplasia, which causes significant facial differences. Growing up in California, Rocky faces constant judgment, discrimination, and misunderstanding from people who struggle to look beyond his appearance. Despite these challenges, he remains intelligent, funny, compassionate, and determined to experience life like any other teenager. His greatest supporter is his mother, Rusty, a fiercely independent woman whose unconventional lifestyle and struggles with addiction create complications within their family. Surrounded by a loyal community of motorcycle enthusiasts who accept him unconditionally, Rocky develops the confidence to pursue friendships, education, and his dreams for the future. As he navigates adolescence, he encounters difficult medical challenges, emotional disappointments, and moments of extraordinary kindness. His life takes a meaningful turn when he meets Diana, a young blind girl who connects with him through his personality rather than his physical appearance. Their growing friendship offers Rocky an opportunity to experience romance and acceptance in a way he rarely has before. Meanwhile, Rusty must confront her own personal struggles while trying to protect her son and prepare him for an uncertain future. Combining powerful performances, heartfelt storytelling, and unforgettable emotional moments, Mask explores motherhood, courage, acceptance, love, friendship, resilience, and the importance of recognizing the beauty and humanity within every person.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • PG-13

🎥 Director: Peter Bogdanovich

✍️ Writer: Anna Hamilton Phelan

source_details.synopsis: Mask is a 1985 American biographical drama film directed by Peter Bogdanovich and written by Anna Hamilton Phelan. It stars Cher, Sam Elliott, and Eric Stoltz. The film is based on the life and early death of Roy L. "Rocky" Dennis, a boy who had craniodiaphyseal dysplasia, an extremely rare genetic disorder known commonly as lionitis due to the disfiguring cranial enlargements that it causes. Mask won the Academy Award for Best Makeup at the 58th ceremony, while Cher and Stoltz received Golden Globe Award nominations for their performances and Cher won the 1985 Cannes Film Festival award for Best Actress.
